senses.gloss: [to stroll idly, saunter (v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 4242),] to live in luxury, to be like a nobleman, to be well-dressed, clean &c. (cmp. פנק, פרנק).
to make look well, polish, dress, cleanse, prepare.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 27a:4">Ḥull. 27ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>וש̇ח̇ט̇</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 1:5">Lev. I, 5</cite>) <he>ממקום שש̇ח̇ חַטֵֹּהוּ</he> from the place where the animal bends (its head, the front of the neck), cleanse it (let its blood run out).
Ib. ממאי דהאי חטהו לישנא דדכויי הוא how can you prove that this ḥattehu has the meaning of cleansing?—
<cite ref="Leviticus 1:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ממקום שס̇ח̇ ח̇ט̇הו</he> from where it utters sound, cleanse it. [<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:2">Cant. R. to VII, 2</cite>, v. infra.]
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:2">Cant. R. to VII, 2</cite> [read:] <he>כל חִיטּוּיִין … שישראל מִתְחַטִּין וכ׳</he> all luxuries and enjoyments which Israel indulge in and enjoy.

<cite ref="Menachot 66b:4">Men. 66ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>נ̇ת̇ע̇ל̇ס̇ה̇</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 7:18">Prov. VII, 18</cite>) <he>נ̇שא ונת̇ן ונע̇לה ונ̇שמח ונִתְחַטֵּא באהבים</he> let us have a conversation, then let us go up and rejoice and delight ourselves with dalliances; Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, ch. XIV, Par. 13. Men. l. c. (play on <he>נ̇ע̇ל̇ס̇ה̇</he> <cite ref="Job 39:13">Job XXXIX, 13</cite>) <he>נ̇וש̇א עול̇ה ונתח̇טא</he>; Sifra l. c. <he>נושא ועולה ומִתְחַטֵּא</he> he (the bird) raises (his wings) and rises and enjoys himself (differ. interpret. in Rashi).

senses.gloss: to show one’s self a nobleman, to be generous, proud.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:7:1">Cant. R. to VII, 7</cite> <he>שהיה מתחטא על וכ׳</he> he was generous towards &c. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 14:23">Gen. XIV, 23</cite>, <cite ref="Daniel 5:17">Dan. V, 17</cite>).

senses.gloss: to be imperious, to lord it, to ask petulantly.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:8">Taan. III, 8</cite> <he>אתה מתח׳ לפני</he> thou comest petulantly before the Lord <he>כבן שהוא מתח׳ על וכ׳</he> like a son that lords it over his father &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:6">Cant. R. to V, 6</cite> (explain. <he>חמק</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:6">ib.</cite>) <he>נתח׳ וכ׳</he> he became petulant, he got angry with me.
